title: 한국해양소년단연맹 육성에 관한 법률 / queue:ADDENDUM:04268:19901227:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Government Organization Act) <Act No. 4268, December 27, 1990>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 through 7 Omitted.

Article 8 (Amendment of Other Acts Following Interministerial Reallocation of Affairs) (1) through (9) Omitted.

(10) The Act on the Fostering of the Korea Sea Explorers Association is partially amended as follows:

In Articles 6 through 10, "Administrator of the Korea Maritime and Port Administration" shall be replaced with "Minister of Sports and Youth".

Articles 9 and 10 Omitted.
